Riding the PANW cybersecurity beat; +6.5% premarket, gapping above Wednesday's $240.18 high with the whole security complex catching a bid. Reports Dec 1.
Semiconductor strength post-NVDA - the chip complex is the morning's leadership theme; +4.9% premarket on ~$516M premarket dollar volume.
